title: Teaching Stations
description: Schema for Demo_Game in-world teaching-station landmark definitions.

id.description: Unique station identifier used by TeleportToStation().

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in the F1 station list.

description.description: One-line summary of the engine feature the station demonstrates.

biome.description: Biome ID the station sits within.

worldX.description: World X coordinate of the station centre.

worldZ.description: World Z coordinate of the station centre.

sceneHint.description: Optional --scene argument that best showcases this station.

markerColour.description: RGB or RGBA colour for the in-world teleport marker.
